explanation.description: Nonblank text of 1 to 4096 characters. The exact length and nonblank requirements are enforced locally.

rule.description: Nonblank text of 1 to 2048 characters. The exact length and nonblank requirements are enforced locally.

items.description: Identifier of 1 to 128 characters, with no whitespace or character below U+0020. The exact identifier requirements are enforced locally.

evidence_ids.description: Between 1 and 32 distinct identifiers; duplicates and excess items are rejected locally.

branch.description: Identifier of 1 to 128 characters, with no whitespace or character below U+0020. The exact identifier requirements are enforced locally. Use the exact branch ID for branch scope, null for global scope. The local parser enforces this scope/branch relationship.

lessons.description: At most 8 lessons; the count is enforced locally. Only supplied evidence IDs may support a lesson. Schema validity does not establish evidence membership or lesson admission.

claim_quote.description: Nonblank text of 1 to 512 characters. The exact length and nonblank requirements are enforced locally. For source_effect or an available claim in unavailable, quote an exact substring of the original hypothesis or reasoning. For forecast use null: its numeric target is bound by forecast_ref, not arbitrary claim text. For unavailable with no original claim, use null. Local validation and evidence binding enforce these conditions.

text.description: Nonblank text of 1 to 512 characters. The exact length and nonblank requirements are enforced locally.

source_quotes.description: At most 2 exact quotes from supplied source fields; this count is enforced locally. A non-unknown source_effect assessment requires at least one quote. For forecast and unavailable use []; the local validator enforces these conditions. Copy each source quote from the exact field named in that quote. controlled_change.parent_body and target_body are operator bodies; controlled_change.before.text and after.text can be complete wrapped functions with different indentation. These fields are not interchangeable. Prefer short single-line literal substrings; use separate quotes when two lines are needed. For a multiline quote preserve every newline and space in the named field. Do not copy a body and label it as the wrapped function, normalize whitespace, or assume a matching quote in another field will be accepted. A matching but unrelated source substring does not support an assessment. Use source quotes for code effects and the observed comparison for forecast agreement; a return statement alone cannot verify a numeric forecast. Literal binding does not prove the assessment or causal explanation.

direct_effect.description: Nonblank text of 1 to 512 characters. The exact length and nonblank requirements are enforced locally.

untested_downstream.description: Nonblank text of 1 to 512 characters. The exact length and nonblank requirements are enforced locally.

experiment_id.description: Identifier of 1 to 128 characters, with no whitespace or character below U+0020. The exact identifier requirements are enforced locally.

forecast_ref.description: Only for forecast: this exact ordinary experiment ID and native delta interval. Null for source_effect and unavailable. Local binding rederives the assessment from the authoritative observation.

mechanism_review.description: One to 4 entries, enforced locally. The entire mechanism_review must fit 4096 characters after canonical ASCII-escaped JSON encoding, including field names. This aggregate limit is enforced locally. Each entry has exactly claim_quote, source_quotes, assessment, direct_effect, untested_downstream, evidence_kind and forecast_ref. evidence_kind is source_effect, forecast or unavailable. For source_effect, claim_quote is a literal substring of original hypothesis.text or reasoning; forecast_ref=null. A non-unknown source_effect assessment requires exact source quotes; it remains an unverified model interpretation. For forecast, claim_quote=null and source_quotes=[]: do not certify arbitrary prose as a numeric forecast. forecast_ref must contain exactly experiment_id (this ordinary experiment ID) and target="native_delta_interval". This refers only to the supplied hypothesis predicted_low/high for the native controller score delta, never paired raw/certified sums or intermediate restart effects. Use OBSERVED_COMPARISON_JSON.forecast: position=inside requires assessment directly_supported, above/below requires contradicted, unavailable requires unknown. The host rederives these numerical facts; your free explanation and effect text remain unverified. For unavailable, forecast_ref=null, source_quotes=[] and assessment=unknown; quote the original claim literally when available, otherwise use claim_quote=null. A spans_zero interval is not negative. No source quote is needed or allowed for a forecast or unavailable entry.

schema.description: One bare JSON object, no markers, fences or surrounding prose. Local response and JSON-block limits remain 262144 and 32768 characters respectively. Shape validity never overrides source/evidence binding or lesson gates.
